name: directory
title: Diocese of Greensburg: Parish Directory
command: pnpm diocese roster import greensburg directory scratch/map-greensburg/scouts/0/directory.json
notes: Scraped 2026-10-22 by scratch/map-greensburg/tools/greensburg_directory.py: the 78 parish links on the directory page, each /parish/?LocationID=NNN page (server-rendered after a redirect; curl works), and the worship-site ids that only the Mass Times Search form lists (060CS/ES/GC/HS/RS Church of the Resurrection, 070CS/LS Our Lady of the Assumption, 190FS/MS St. Francis of Assisi), giving 84 entries, one per worship site; group = parish name for those three. Coordinates from the WP Go Maps markers (wp-json/wpgmza/v1/markers/, map 1, one pin per parish); the non-main sites have no pin. mass_times is the page's Saturday/Sunday line only (pages say to ask the parish for daily Masses). pastor = the clergy member listed as pastor/rector/administrator (Ascension and Sacred Heart, Jeannette list a deacon as administrator). partner_parishes is the page's own 'Partner Parishes' field. The base 060 page lists stale clergy and 'no Mass'; the site pages were used. Websites as listed, not checked.
